notes.title: Lagoon Lounge 1 has been updated to version 3.0.0.
notes.content:
Lagoon Lounge 1 has been updated to version 3.0.0.
The UI has been changed to match the release of Lagoon Lounge 2, and several bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: About transferring saved data
notes.content:
Due to a change in the folder where Lagoon Lounge saves are stored after the November 4th update, we are experiencing a problem with the transfer of saved data from before the update.
If you want to transfer your saved data from before the update, please overwrite and copy your saved data to "SaveNewLagoonProject" in the "LagoonLounge" folder below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32799621/09625fb958f26fd9253e741fbca418ecce736154.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32799621/4229b79b5b0000d398acdc74f607fb9c9009a243.jpg[/img]

The saved data before the update is stored in the "LagoonLounge_Patched" or "LagoonLoungeRemastered" folder.
Thank you for your patience.
